team.name: Steel Surge
team.intro: We're a FIRST Tech Challenge team of middle and high school students from the Unionville-Chadds Ford School District. Every season we design, build, and program a robot from scratch — and share what we learn with our community.
team.school: Unionville High School & Charles F. Patton Middle School

members.name: Daniel Thomas
members.bio: Runs Steel Surge's communication, socials, and outreach, and helps out as an assistant programmer. Also into debate, tutoring, Tech Olympics, and student government.

members.name: Idris Bhatti
members.bio: Oversees the CAD, design, and build departments, and makes sure the robot actually comes together. Off the field, plays tennis.

members.name: Nathan Thomas
members.bio: Leads the code that makes the robot move — from autonomous routines to driver controls. Second season with Steel Surge.

members.name: Nikhil Kaza
members.bio: Turns ideas into 3D models before a single part is cut. Passionate about STEM education and helps across the team.

members.name: Siru Panchomarthi
members.bio: Our first driver, behind the controller at every match, and part of the mechanical design and build crew.

members.name: Ethan Harris
members.bio: Brings prior mechanical experience to the team and is up for anything. Wants to take on more complex builds.

members.name: Thomas Binder
members.bio: Supports CAD, outreach, and programming — a true all-rounder who helps wherever the team needs it.

members.name: Rithwik Aluru
members.bio: Connects with businesses to find sponsors who help keep the team running, and is gearing up to join the build.

values.title: Gracious Professionalism
values.body: We compete hard and help harder. Lending a part or a hand to another team is part of how we play.

values.title: Build, break, rebuild
values.body: Every prototype teaches us something. We test early, fail fast, and keep iterating until it works under match pressure.

values.title: Share what we learn
values.body: From Intro to Robotics sessions to outreach events, we bring the next group of students into STEM.

achievements.title: Team founded
achievements.detail: Steel Surge registers as FTC Team 27254 for its rookie season.

achievements.title: First competition
achievements.detail: Debuted our first robot at the Longhorn Roundup Scrimmage, finishing 2–2.

achievements.title: 4–1 qualifier run
achievements.detail: Our best qualification record yet at the Southeastern Pennsylvania Qualifier.

updates.title: Season kickoff
updates.body: We kicked off the new FTC season with a full-team brainstorm and strategy session, broke down this year's game, and started mapping out our robot.

updates.title: Build week 1
updates.body: Drivetrain testing is underway. Our new gear setup should give us more torque without giving up the speed we need to score.

featuredVideos.title: When ping pong gets too intense

sponsorPitch: Running a robotics team takes real resources: parts, tools, competition fees, travel, and outreach events. Your support keeps students building, learning, and sharing STEM with the community — and puts your name in front of families, schools, and the FIRST community all season long.

sponsorTiers.name: Platinum
perks: Recognition on social media and website
